title: Build: backtest_pairs.py measures 1R on the rolling-beta spread series, so beta drift inflates risk ~775x and deflates cost-in-R; fix the R scale (risk at the entry-bar beta) and give pairs_dollar_lots.py slippage + funding
note: [2026-10-14 lane P3-STRATEGY-PROGRAMME] MEASURED: committed ledger comms/research/RQ-20261007-005/<run>/trades.jsonl (pairs_sol_eth, n=304) mean cost_r 0.0014 R per pair trade with risk_spread ~1.34; recomputed on Binance Vision SOLUSDT/ETHUSDT 1h May 2026 with the harness's _rolling_beta(15): spread std 1.63 rolling vs 0.0021 at the entry-bar beta (beta sigma 0.61 x log ETH ~7.8), so 2 x 10.5 bps costs 0.0006 R in the harness vs ~0.50 R honestly. Consequence: RQ-20261007-005..008's four PASSes (+51.8..+102.4 R) are unreadable as net-of-cost evidence; their honest sign is UNKNOWN (gross R is in the same inflated units). FIX (Tier-1 research harness, scripts/backtest_pairs.py): risk = stop_z x std over the lookback of (la - beta_entry x lb) with beta frozen at entry; P&L in R on the same fixed-beta spread; self-test plants a rolling-beta case whose cost_r is within 10% of the fixed-beta figure. Also scripts/research/pairs_dollar_lots.py: slippage + funding from execution_costs.resolve_cost_policy (fee-only today). [2026-10-16 lane PAIRS-ALPACA-BUILD-1016] OPEN QUESTION ANSWERED (read from code on main dbfc24a6, not measured on live fills): YES, the live executor sizes on the same rolling-beta quantity. pairs_engine.entry_signal sets risk = stop_z x std of s = logA - beta_t*logB with beta_t rolling (shift-1); pairs_executor.decide_pair passes sig["risk"] to pairs_sizing.pair_notionals (N_A = budget / risk) and to leg_protective_levels; exit_signal compares the rolling-beta spread to stop_spread. So every bybit_1 pair with hedge_beta: rolling (all four Bybit pairs) is undersized by the inflation factor, and its stop/revert are read on the drifting series. Planted SOL/ETH-like 1h case in tests/test_pairs_risk_scale.py: first natural entry has risk/fixed-beta-risk ~87x. hedge_beta: one (pairs_gld_gdx) is unaffected by construction (ratio 1.0, tested). Operator 2026-10-16 (relayed by the manager, not found as a record on main): Bybit pairs paper legs keep running on paper while this is fixed. No fix PR exists as of 2026-10-16 15:30Z (searched PRs updated since 10-14). The live-engine fix must land WITH the harness fix (engine mirrors backtest_pairs.py): freeze beta at entry, carry beta_entry in OpenPair, read stop/revert on the fixed-beta spread. The Alpaca path cannot inherit it: the Tier-2 HELD PR on PAIRS-ALPACA-BUILD adds pairs_engine.fixed_beta_risk, both R units + ratio on every Bybit/Alpaca soak row, and skip_risk_scale on the session venue when the ratio is off 1 by >1%.
